$description: Performance budgets (#1188), read by tools/checks/perf-budget.mjs on the built CDN files. A limit is never raised to pass: lower it in the same PR when a measure drops well below it; raising one needs a decision record with G3 (DS Architect). The total size of plenix.css is printed, never limited (owner, plenix-platform#460).

scopeTokens.why: Custom properties declared in one CSS scope that reaches elements other than :root. Each such element recomputes them for its whole subtree. After ADR 0050 (#1197) the largest is the theme scope ':root, [data-plx-theme], [data-plx-mode]' at 2,345 (only :root and ThemeZones match it); 1.6.1 had 5,563 on the density scope (#1188, lowered in #1205).

densityTokens.why: The largest scope listing [data-plx-density] or [data-plx-interaction] alone: every DataGrid and density zone matches it, so it is the grid's style-recalculation cost. After ADR 0050 (#1197): 338 on ':root, [data-plx-density], [data-plx-interaction]' (each forced-colors copy, 106, is its own scope). 1.6.1 had 5,563 there (#1188).

jsBrotli.why: plenix.js on the wire, brotli quality 5 (the web host's setting, deploy/web/plenix-compression.conf). 1.6.1: 552,947 B; nginx compresses in chunks, so the wire shows about 3% more (571,727 B live on 2026-11-10).

traces.why: Owner rule 7 (D-0160, #1201): main content within 2.5 s (LCP) and a click answered within 0.2 s (INP) on each reference page (tests/perf/pages.mjs: a DataGrid with 50 rows, a record page, a form), median of the harness's loads on the PR's own build. 1.6.1 baseline (docs/pds1/slices/1201/evidence/baseline-1.6.1.json): grid 248/24, record 72/16, form 76/0 ms. A page missing from the trace fails.

bundles.why: Code per screen (ADR 0052, #1208, owner rule 2): each CDN entry esm/<Export>.js with the files it imports (esm/manifest.json), brotli 5, at most entryLimit unless named in limits (the 1.6.1 build plus 2%; each named one is an on-demand candidate: load its large code on first use, then lower or drop its limit). screens: a screen's parts together (shared files once); grid 1.6.1: 233,539 B, against 552,947 B for plenix.js. loaderLimit: plenix-loader.js raw bytes (1.6.1: 3,389).
